_note: Status of each Prospeo filter key this skill writes. seen = in a link captured from the user's own Prospeo dashboard; documented = in Prospeo's official filters documentation (https://prospeo.io/api-docs/filters-documentation, last updated 5 Aug 2026, read 22 Nov 2026), which says the dashboard's own 'Search API' view shows the same payload, but not yet seen in a link from the user's account; locked = needs a higher plan than the user's (Free).
